name: Anna Liem
reason: Health restore re-check, 13 Nov 2026: her own site annaliem.nl (home and /handpan pages, robots.txt allows us) is still mainly a clinical music-therapy practice: sessions framed around trauma-related complaints, attachment problems and psychological difficulties, billed through the Dutch care-performance model (ZPM) with her treating psychologist, a multidisciplinary team including a psychiatrist, GP referrals and a waiting list. That is therapy, out of scope. Outside it there is only one private handpan listening session (relaxation; recordings on Insight Timer, never opened) plus affiliate links to other people's handpan courses and shops, so too thin (about 1 item) for a listing.
